title: Word-Reversal Symmetry, Darboux Block Obstructions, and a General codim(Sing) + 2 Determinantal Complexity Bound for Degree-n >= 4 Hypersurfaces (with a Self-Contained Application to dc_C(perm_4) >= 10)
description:
We develop an algebraic symmetry and obstruction framework explaining how origin-isotropy traps matrix operator chains in higher-order singular strata. First, in the free associative algebra A = C<m_1,...,m_s> equipped with the word-reversal anti-involution rho(m_{i_1}...m_{i_k}) = m_{i_k}...m_{i_1}, we prove that any representation Phi satisfying the two initial skew-symmetry conditions K^T = -K and (Phi(m_i)K)^T = -Phi(m_i)K satisfies the universal identity (Phi(P)K)^T = -Phi(rho(P))K for all P in A. We establish necessary and sufficient conditions for quadratic annihilation (y^T Phi(P)K y = 0 iff Phi(P^-)K = 0), derive exact dimension formulas dim A_k^+- = (s^k +- s^{ceil(k/2)})/2, and characterize the admissible operator space L_K in a Darboux basis of K (rank(K) = 2r <= d_v).

Second, we apply this characterization to Algebraic Branching Programs (ABPs) and linear time-invariant (LTI) control systems: we show that two vanishing initial Markov parameters force the entire infinite Hankel matrix H_infinity to collapse to zero, prove a width lower bound w >= codim Sing(V(F)) + 1 for time-homogeneous and palindromic ABPs, and prove that even for completely non-homogeneous ABPs with arbitrary distinct layer matrices, the Hessian rank on W^perp is bounded by rank Hess(F)(xi) <= 2r = rank(K) <= w - d_z.

Third, we prove a general unconditional determinantal complexity theorem extending the Alper-Bogart-Velasco (2017) bound (dc_C(F) >= codim Sing(V(F)) + 1): for every homogeneous polynomial F of degree n >= 4 satisfying codim Sing(V(F)) >= 5 and codim Sing_2(V(F)) > codim Sing(V(F)), one has unconditionally dc_C(F) >= codim Sing(V(F)) + 2. As a self-contained concrete application, this yields dc_C(perm_4) >= 10.
